tagline: Global asset manager delivering investment solutions to help clients achieve their financial goals
hero_kpi_rationale: AUM is the key indicator of the company's ability to attract and retain client assets, directly linked to its revenue generation and overall financial health.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Total amount of assets managed by the company
kpis.description: AUM is a key indicator of the company's financial health

kpis.name: Operating Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated from the company's operating activities
kpis.description: Operating revenues are a key indicator of the company's revenue generation

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profitability ratio of the company
kpis.description: Operating margin measures operational profitability before taxes and interest

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to Invesco Ltd.
kpis.description: Net income measures net profitability after all expenses and taxes

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Income (non-GAAP)
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating income excluding non-GAAP impacts
kpis.description: Adjusted operating income is a non-GAAP measure of underlying operational performance
kpis.signal: Significant growth in adjusted operating income

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Income (non-GAAP)
kpis.explanation: Adjusted net income excluding non-GAAP impacts
kpis.description: Adjusted net income is a non-GAAP measure of underlying net profitability
kpis.signal: Significant growth in adjusted net income

risks.title: Market Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions risks related to global and regional market volatility, particularly regarding assets under management and revenues. Potential systemic disruptions could lead to significant AUM declines.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive asset management sector where fee and performance competition is intensifying, potentially reducing revenues and market share.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company highlights uncertainties surrounding geopolitical developments (sovereignty, borders, social instability) that could impact financial markets and assets under management.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risk through its cash deposits and investments in money market instruments. Credit concentration could create significant exposures.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates globally and is exposed to fluctuations in foreign exchange rates, which impact foreign currency revenues and AUM values.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to complex and evolving regulations regarding asset management, capital and liquidity requirements, which could increase costs.

risks.title: Inflation Risks
risks.score_rationale: Inflation may increase compensation costs and other operating expenses. It may also reduce AUM values if it leads to higher interest rates.

ai_positioning.summary: Invesco mentions the risks and opportunities related to companies directly involved in AI or exposed to AI trends, particularly those in the Nasdaq-100 Index, reflecting exposure to this strategic sector through products such as the Invesco QQQ Trust.
evidence: In the event that market values of companies involved directly in AI or exposed to AI trends, including those that are part of the Nasdaq-100 Index, decline, we may suffer declines in AUM and revenue, particularly relating to products we advise that track the Nasdaq-100 Index, such as the Invesco QQQ Trust and the Invesco NASDAQ 100 ETF.
